obs: "The fact that the legislature has seen fit, for the additional safety of travellers, imperatively to require the corporation to give certain warnings at such crossings, does not relieve it from the duty of doing whatever else may be reasonably necessary."
Rainier Brewing Co. v. Great Northern Pacific Steamship Co.

"Under the general law of carriers, it was the duty of the railroad company to make delivery to the consignees ... and the requirement of the statute that the delivering carrier must deface and cancel the permit on each package, added to the imperative character of this obligation."
